content.value: This work gathers four projects from my second and third years. Each approaches its subject differently, but all reflect a growing interest in science communication, visualising complex ideas for non-specialist audiences.

Fast-paced coursework left some pieces rushed or proof-of-concept; I include them here as markers in my development toward design grounded in research, technology, and accessible storytelling, early steps toward the question of where practice might lead, and what from these projects is worth keeping.
